sourceIdentity.pageTitle: Pet Adoption App — Onboarding / Sign In / Home (3-screen mockup)

pageStateLock.currentState: Three distinct mobile app screens shown side-by-side on a deep magenta presentation backdrop: (1) Onboarding welcome with hero image + bottom sheet, (2) Sign in form with social auth + email fields, (3) Home dashboard with greeting, category pills, circular pet product cards and expensive-cat section.

do not convert mobile screens to desktop layout
do not change deep magenta primary color to another hue
do not replace circular product cards with rectangular cards
do not remove Dynamic Island / iOS status bar
do not change onboarding hero image to a different subject

referenceCaptureEvidence.captureDescription: Single user-provided PNG showing 3 iPhone-style mobile screens (Dynamic Island) of a pet adoption app on a deep magenta backdrop. Screens: onboarding, sign-in, home dashboard.

measuredSourceFacts.fact: Each of the 3 screens is an iPhone 14 Pro style mobile frame with Dynamic Island notch; per-screen viewport approx 390x844pt; status bar shows 9:41 with signal/wifi/battery in dark icons.

restoreVisualCheckpoints.sourceObservation: Deep magenta #C2185B is the singular primary accent: fills Next CTA, Get Started CTA, With Google button; Sign in header text is same magenta.

restoreVisualCheckpoints.sourceObservation: Onboarding headline 'Proud to Be a Pet Adopter' ~26px bold near-black; subtext ~14px regular gray; Sign in header ~28px bold magenta.

project.visualSpecExcerpt:
=== VISUAL SPEC (shared across 3 mobile pages, viewport 390x844) ===
[LAYOUT]
onboarding: hero img top 0/height 58vh + white card bottom 0/height 42vh/radius-top 32px
signin: centered column, 24px side padding, top paw logo, Sign in header, social auth, divider, 2 inputs, CTA, footer
home: header row (hamburger/greeting/avatar/search) + category pills row + 2 circular cards row + See more + Expensive Cat section + bottom nav
[SPACING]
card-padding: 24px
field-gap: 16px
headline-subtext-gap: 12px
subtext-cta-gap: 24px
section-gap: 20px
pill-gap: 10px
[TYPOGRAPHY]
signin-header: 28px/36px 700 #C2185B
headline: 26px/32px 700 #1A1A1A
subtext: 14px/20px 400 #9E9E9E
greeting-name: 20px/26px 700 #1A1A1A
greeting-sub: 13px/18px 400 #9E9E9E
price: 16px/22px 700 #1A1A1A
category-label: 14px/20px 500
link: 14px/20px 600 #C2185B
[COLORS]
primary: #C2185B
primary-text: #1A1A1A
muted: #9E9E9E
border: #E0E0E0
surface: #FFFFFF
paw-red: #E53935
card-coral: #FF8A80
selected-pill: #1A1A1A
success: #4CAF50
[SHADOWS & DEPTH]
onboarding-card-shadow: 0 -8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)
cta-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(194,24,91,0.25)
card-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)
[RADII]
cta-pill: 30px
category-pill: 20px
input: 16px
onboarding-card-top: 32px
circular-card: 50%
avatar: 50%
=== END SPEC ===

Each page renders its own bottom navigation inline (only home.html has a bottom tab bar); there is no cross-page shared navigation router.

mobileNavigation.reason: Restore 1:1 of 3 standalone static app screens; bottom nav is rendered inline per-page, not as a shared router shell.
